title: Bet amount remains locked in the `Flip` contract when player wins
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  When a game is completed and the player wins, a percentage of the bet amount (fee) is sent to the manager and/or the staking contract. But the rest of the bet amount remains locked forever.  This means that for every game won, the protocol loses `netPayout` tokens, while for every game lost, the protocol gains `betAmount` tokens.
